title.value: What if We Enrich day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting with Spatio-Temporal Context?
title.justification: The paper's core topic is about using spatio-temporal context for improving day-ahead solar irradiance forecasting.
title.quote: Title of the paper: What if We Enrich day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting with Spatio-Temporal Context?

extractions.description: The paper presents a deep learning architecture, CrossViViT, which enhances day-ahead solar irradiance forecasting by incorporating spatio-temporal context from satellite data. It focuses on predicting Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI) with high accuracy and robust performance, even in stations not seen during training. This approach aids in more efficient integration of solar power into the electrical grid, hence contributing to climate change mitigation by reducing CO2 emissions.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme is improving solar power integration into the grid to mitigate climate change, directly aiming at reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Solar power is a vital renewable energy source with the potential to mitigate climate change effects by reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
